### 2012–2014: _Hit Me Like a Man EP_, commercial success with _Going to Hell_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Pretty_Reckless&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: 2012–2014: Hit Me Like a Man EP, commercial success with Going to Hell")]

Main article: [_Going to Hell_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Going_to_Hell "Going to Hell")

[The Medicine Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Medicine_Tour "The Medicine Tour") was the second headlining concert tour by the Pretty Reckless in support of their 2010 debut album _[Light Me Up](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Light\_Me\_Up "Light Me Up")_ and their 2012 extended play _[Hit Me Like a Man EP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit\_Me\_Like\_a\_Man\_EP "Hit Me Like a Man EP")_.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-41) The tour dates were announced on January 23, 2012, via the band's official website. The band performed at several of the same venues they had visited the previous year, with 52 shows in North America, 5 shows in South America and 2 shows in Asia. Directly following those tour dates, the Pretty Reckless supported [Marilyn Manson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marilyn_Manson "Marilyn Manson") on their tour, [Hey Cruel World... Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hey_Cruel_World..._Tour "Hey Cruel World... Tour").[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-42) On July 29, the band performed a show in [Buenos Aires](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buenos_Aires "Buenos Aires").[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-43) In September 2012, the Pretty Reckless headlined the Bazooka Rocks Festival in [Manila](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metro_Manila "Metro Manila"), Philippines, ending their the Medicine Tour.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-44)

Their second [extended play](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extended_play "Extended play")_[Hit Me Like a Man EP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit\_Me\_Like\_a\_Man\_EP "Hit Me Like a Man EP")_ was released on March 6, 2012.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-45) It featured three new songs, as well as live performances of two songs from _[Light Me Up](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Light\_Me\_Up "Light Me Up")_.[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-46) A new song by the band titled "Only You" was included as a bonus track of _[Frankenweenie Unleashed!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankenweenie\_Unleashed! "Frankenweenie Unleashed!")_, the soundtrack album of _[Frankenweenie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankenweenie\_(2012\_film) "Frankenweenie (2012 film)")_ (2012).[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-47) On December 11, 2012, the Pretty Reckless' released the single, "[Kill Me](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kill_Me_(The_Pretty_Reckless_song) "Kill Me (The Pretty Reckless song)")".[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-48) The song was featured at the end of the [final episode](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York,_I_Love_You_XOXO "New York, I Love You XOXO") of the series _[Gossip Girl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gossip\_Girl\_(TV\_series) "Gossip Girl (TV series)")_.[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-49)

On May 30, 2013, the Pretty Reckless released a teaser trailer for their second studio album _[Going to Hell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Going\_to\_Hell\_(album) "Going to Hell (album)")_, set for release later that year.[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-50) On June 17, 2013, the Pretty Reckless released a new track titled "Follow Me Down".[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-51) On July 1, 2013, Momsen released the song "Burn", which will also be on _Going to Hell_.[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-52)

The song "Going to Hell" premiered on September 19, 2013.[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-altpress_September_19,_2013-53)[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-54) On the same day as the premier of the new track "Going to Hell", the Pretty Reckless also announced their signing to the label [Razor & Tie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Razor_&_Tie "Razor & Tie").[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-55)[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-56) On September 20, 2013, the Pretty Reckless began the [Going to Hell Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Going_to_Hell_Tour "Going to Hell Tour") to support the album,[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-altpress_September_19,_2013-53) together with [Heaven's Basement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heaven's_Basement "Heaven's Basement").[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-57) The "Going to Hell" official music video was released on October 16, 2013.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-58)[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-59) ON November 19, 2013, the second single "Heaven Knows" was released.[[60]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-60) The music video appeared on February 13, 2014.[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-61)

_Going to Hell_ was released on March 18, 2014.[[62]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-62)[[63]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-63) The release marked the band's largest sales week to date and landed at number five on the _Billboard_ 200 with over 35,000 copies sold in its first week.[[64]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-64) Much of the inspiration for the album came from Momsen's Catholic background, noting that "heaven and hell is a metaphor that's been used in music since the beginning of time".[[65]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-65)

When the singles "[Heaven Knows](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heaven_Knows_(The_Pretty_Reckless_song) "Heaven Knows (The Pretty Reckless song)")" and "[Messed Up World (F'd Up World)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Messed_Up_World_(F'd_Up_World) "Messed Up World (F'd Up World)")" topped the US [Mainstream Rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mainstream_Rock_(chart) "Mainstream Rock (chart)") chart, the Pretty Reckless became the second female-fronted band to achieve two number ones in a row on the chart, following [the Pretenders](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretenders "The Pretenders").[[66]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-blabber2014-66)[[67]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-67) 2014 also saw Momsen performing at the Revolver Magazine Golden Gods awards alongside Joan Jett and ZZ Top guitarist Billy Gibbons.[[68]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-68) The band also performed "Heaven Knows", "Fucked Up World", and "Going to Hell" at the awards show.[[69]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-69)

### 2015–2017: _Who You Selling For_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Pretty_Reckless&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: 2015–2017: Who You Selling For")]

Main article: [_Who You Selling For_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Who_You_Selling_For "Who You Selling For")

Writing for the band's third album began shortly after the completion of two years of touring in support of the band's second studio album, _[Going to Hell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Going\_to\_Hell "Going to Hell")_ (2014).

> "We had so much we wanted to say, it was like shaking a can of soda on tour, and then when we started writing we cracked the seal", Momsen said. "The touring life is very isolating. You look at the world through a bus or airplane window. But music is the healing factor. It's the one thing that is grounding and a true companion through the forest. It saved us—again."[[70]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-blabbermouth_2016-70)

The band released "[Take Me Down](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Take_Me_Down_(The_Pretty_Reckless_song) "Take Me Down (The Pretty Reckless song)")" as the lead single for their third studio album on July 15, 2016.[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-71) It became the band's fourth single to top the Mainstream Rock chart[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-72) and was serviced to US [active rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Active_rock "Active rock") radio on July 19.[[73]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-73) The music video for "Take Me Down" was released on September 29, 2016.[[74]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-74) The band's third studio album, _[Who You Selling For](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Who\_You\_Selling\_For "Who You Selling For")_, was released on October 21, 2016, by [Razor & Tie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Razor_&_Tie "Razor & Tie").[[70]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-blabbermouth_2016-70)[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-75)

The band's [Who You Selling For Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Who_You_Selling_For_Tour "Who You Selling For Tour") started in October 3, 2016 with a show in Paris, France, followed by Berlin, Germany on October 6 and London, England on October 10.[[76]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-76) The band then played various shows in North America from October 20 to December 6, 2016.[[77]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-77) The official music video for the album's second single "Oh My God" was released on February 8, 2017.[[78]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-78) During the tour, on May 17, 2017, the band was the opening act for [Soundgarden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soundgarden "Soundgarden") during lead vocalist [Chris Cornell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chris_Cornell "Chris Cornell")'s last performance, at the [Fox Theater](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fox_Theatre_(Detroit) "Fox Theatre (Detroit)") in [Detroit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Detroit "Detroit"), [Michigan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michigan "Michigan"), before his suicide. The Pretty Reckless paid tribute to Cornell by performing a cover version of [Audioslave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audioslave "Audioslave")'s "[Like a Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_a_Stone "Like a Stone")" on May 20 at the Philadelphia radio station [WMMR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WMMR "WMMR")'s annual MMR-B-Q at [BB&T Pavilion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BB&T_Pavilion "BB&T Pavilion") in [Camden, New Jersey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camden,_New_Jersey "Camden, New Jersey").[[79]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-79) A third single, "[Back to the River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Back_to_the_River_(song) "Back to the River (song)")", featuring [Warren Haynes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warren_Haynes "Warren Haynes") of [Gov't Mule](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gov't_Mule "Gov't Mule") and the [Allman Brothers Band](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allman_Brothers_Band "Allman Brothers Band")[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-80) was released on June 13, 2017.[[81]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-81)

### 2018–2024: _Death by Rock and Roll_ and _Other Worlds_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Pretty_Reckless&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: 2018–2024: Death by Rock and Roll and Other Worlds")]

Main article: [_Death by Rock and Roll_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_by_Rock_and_Roll "Death by Rock and Roll")

The band's longtime-producer, [Kato Khandwala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kato_Khandwala "Kato Khandwala"), was involved in a [motorcycle accident](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motorcycle_accident "Motorcycle accident") in April 2018 and died later due to injuries from the crash.[[82]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-82)[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-83)[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-84) Speaking about Khandwala's death, Taylor Momsen stated:

> "That was the nail in the coffin for me. I threw my hands up in the air and kind of went 'Yeah, I give up.' I went down a very dark rabbit hole of depression and substance abuse and everything that comes with that."[[85]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-85)

In November 2019, Momsen revealed on [Instagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram "Instagram") that the band was working on their fourth studio album with [Matt Cameron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matt_Cameron "Matt Cameron") of [Pearl Jam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pearl_Jam "Pearl Jam") and [Soundgarden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soundgarden "Soundgarden").[[86]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-86) In February 2020, Momsen confirmed the album's completion and revealed its title, _[Death by Rock and Roll](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death\_by\_Rock\_and\_Roll "Death by Rock and Roll")_.[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-87) The lead single, which is the [title track](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_by_Rock_and_Roll_(song) "Death by Rock and Roll (song)") of the album, was released on May 15, 2020.[[88]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-88)[[89]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-89) The band's tour was set to begin in September 2020, having been delayed from May 2020 due to the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic "COVID-19 pandemic").[[90]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-90) In May 2020, the band signed with [Fearless Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fearless_Records "Fearless Records").[[91]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-91)

The Pretty Reckless became the first female-fronted band to have five singles reach the top of the Mainstream Rock chart when "[Death by Rock and Roll](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_by_Rock_and_Roll_(song) "Death by Rock and Roll (song)")" rose to its top spot.[[92]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Rutherford-92) The Halloween-themed "Broomsticks" was released in late October,[[93]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-93) and "25" was released on November 13.[[94]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-94) On January 8, 2021, the band released "And So It Went" featuring [Tom Morello](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Morello "Tom Morello") as the next single for _Death by Rock and Roll_.[[95]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-95)[[96]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-96) Momsen stated that the song comments on the world's current "civil unrest": "The world has been in such a state of civil unrest. 'And So It Went' basically comes from that vision. As a songwriter, I feel like I'm not here to preach. I use music to observe and communicate what I see around me."[[97]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-97) The album was released on February 12, 2021.[[98]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-98)[[99]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-99)

The band returned to touring for the first time since the Who You Selling For Tour when they joined [Shinedown](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shinedown "Shinedown") on their Revolutions Live Tour.[[100]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Revolutions_Live_Tour-100)[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Revolutions_Live_Tour2-101) The tour started on April 1 in [Spokane, Washington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spokane,_Washington "Spokane, Washington") and wrapped up on May 7, 2022, in [Knoxville, Tennessee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knoxville,_Tennessee "Knoxville, Tennessee").[[100]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Revolutions_Live_Tour-100)[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Revolutions_Live_Tour2-101) In March 2022, it was announced that the band would be joining [Halestorm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halestorm "Halestorm") for a summer tour. The tour began on July 8 and concluded on August 12, 2022.[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-102) On July 15, 2022, the band performed at Rock Fest in [Cadott, Wisconsin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadott,_Wisconsin "Cadott, Wisconsin").[[103]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-103) The tour visited the UK and Ireland in October and November 2022.[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-104) In August 2022, the band announced the release of _Other Worlds_, a compilation album containing alternate versions of previously released songs and new covers, for November 4 that year. A remix of "Got So High" from _Death by Rock and Roll_ was released as a single ahead of the compilation's release.[[105]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-105)[[106]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Blabbermouth.net_2023-106) In May 2023, the band announced that they entered the studio to work on their fifth studio album.[[106]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Blabbermouth.net_2023-106)

Just as the Pretty Reckless started recording their next album, they delayed it to tour as the opening act of [AC/DC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC/DC "AC/DC")'s [Power Up Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_Up_Tour "Power Up Tour") from May 2024 to September 2026, aside from late 2025 concerts in Australia.[[107]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-107)[[108]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-108)

### 2025–present: _Dear God_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Pretty_Reckless&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: 2025–present: Dear God")]

Main article: [Dear God](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dear_God_(album) "Dear God (album)")

On July 28, 2025, it was announced that the band will be featured on a tribute album for the band, [Bad Company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bad_Company "Bad Company"). Titled _Can't Get Enough: A Tribute To Bad Company_, it was released on October 24, 2025, with the band performing on the song "All Right Now".[[109]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-109) On August 22, 2025, the band released their first new song in four years, "[For I Am Death](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/For_I_Am_Death "For I Am Death")", alongside an accompanying music video.[[110]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-110)[[111]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-111) On October 10, 2025, the band announced a Christmas EP titled, _Taylor Momsen's Pretty Reckless Christmas_, with a release date of October 31 for digital, and November 14 for physical copies. Along with the announcement, the band released a reimagining of "[Where Are You Christmas?](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Where_Are_You_Christmas%3F "Where Are You Christmas?")". The song was originally performed by Momsen when she portrayed Cindy Lou Who in the 2000 film _[How The Grinch Stole Christmas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/How\_the\_Grinch\_Stole\_Christmas\_(2000\_film) "How the Grinch Stole Christmas (2000 film)")_.[[112]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-112) On March 13, 2026, the band released the single, "When I Wake Up". On the same day, they also announced their fifth studio album, _[Dear God](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dear\_God\_(album) "Dear God (album)")_, which was released on June 26, 2026.[[113]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-113) A music video for the song was released five days later.[[114]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-114) The album's third single, "Love Me", was released on April 17, 2026.[[115]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-115) The album's fourth single, "Dear God", was released on May 22, 2026.[[116]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-116) A music video for the title track was released on June 29.[[117]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-117) In 2026, the addition of touring guitarist Logan Nikolic was confirmed.[[118]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Nikolic-118)

## Musical style and influences

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Pretty_Reckless&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Musical style and influences")]

The Pretty Reckless has been described as [hard rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_rock "Hard rock"),[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-AMG_Bio-3)[[119]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Ashley_Zlatopolsky-119)[[120]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Vicky_Greer-120)[[121]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-121)[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-UG_genres-122)[alternative rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternative_rock "Alternative rock"),[[123]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-123)[[124]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-124)[[125]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-125)[post-grunge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Post-grunge "Post-grunge"),[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-AMG_Bio-3)[[126]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-126)[blues rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blues_rock "Blues rock"),[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-UG_genres-122)[[127]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-127) and [grunge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grunge "Grunge").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-The_Guardian-9) According to _Louder Sound_, "[the band mixes] the finer elements of [heavy metal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heavy_metal_music "Heavy metal music") with grunge and [blues](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blues "Blues"). Ben Phillips' gritty riffs gave Momsen a platform to make singles Miss Nothing and Make Me Wanna Die teem with attitude, while the softer moments, such as Just Tonight, set up the singer...as a vocal force to be reckoned with.[[120]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-Vicky_Greer-120)[BBC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC "BBC") described the band as "grunge-[pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music "Pop music")".[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-BBC_July_10-33)_[Ultimate Guitar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate\_Guitar "Ultimate Guitar")_ noted elements of [psychedelia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psychedelic_music "Psychedelic music"), blues, [folk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contemporary_folk_music "Contemporary folk music"), and [Southern rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Southern_rock "Southern rock") on their third album, _[Who You Selling For](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Who\_You\_Selling\_For "Who You Selling For")_.[[122]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-UG_genres-122) The band's fourth album, _[Death by Rock and Roll](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death\_by\_Rock\_and\_Roll "Death by Rock and Roll")_, had touches of [country rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Country_rock "Country rock"), [folk rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Folk_rock "Folk rock"), and [Americana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Americana_(music) "Americana (music)"), on the tracks, "Rock and Roll Heaven" and "Harley Darling",[[128]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-128)[[129]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-129) along with their typical hard rock sound.[[130]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pretty_Reckless#cite_note-130)

# How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?

![Image 1: How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rebecca-ferguson_c1.png?ar=16%3A9&fit=crop&crop=top&auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

by[Rebecca Lancaster](link_45)|

Updated on 10th March 2026 at 1.05pm

* * *

[Follow Mother & Baby on Google](link_46)

What age do you think is the best time to become a mother? According to recent statistics, nearly half (49%) of all live births were to mothers aged 30 and over, with the average age for first-time mothers coming in at 28.1 years.

But what about celebrities? We round up some of the most high-profile mothers, from Adele and Lily Allen who chose to become mothers in their twenties, to Halle Berry and Nicole Kidman who are welcoming bundles of joy into their lives well into their forties...

## How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?

![Image 2: How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rebecca-ferguson_c1.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)1 of 15

### Rebecca Ferguson

Singer and X-Factor finalist Rebecca, 27, became a mum at the tender age of 18 with ex-partner Karl Dures and has a daughter Lillie May, 10, and son Karl Jr, eight.'  
 Karl was my first love. It was a surprise when Lillie May came along and it was hard to deal with, but a lot of young girls are in that situation,’ she said of her first pregnancy. Rebecca has recently confirmed that she is[now pregnant with her third child](link_47)with her current partner, who has chosen to stay out of the limelight.

![Image 3: Lily Allen](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-3216288ar_c1.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)2 of 15

### Lily Allen

Lily Allen, 28, first became a mother at 26 with Ethel, now two, and welcomed her second child with husband Sam Cooper in January 2013, Marnie (15 months).  
 The outspoken singer made her pop comeback last year after a three-year career break, telling a French radio station, ‘I thought I'd be a really happy mum just sitting at home, playing with my kids; that was my dream. I love my children, but I'm a very impatient, busy person naturally so two babies, neither of them can talk, it was[quite boring](link_48)!’

![Image 4: Megan Fox](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/157928596_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)3 of 15

### Megan Fox

Voted the World’s Sexiest Woman on numerous occasions, actress and Transformers star Megan Fox, 27, became a mum in her mid-twenties with baby Noah (16 months).  
 Happy to settle down, she told a newspaper: ‘I love it. It’s what I’ve wanted to do since I was a little girl. I always wanted to mother things and I constantly had a doll I was taking care of. I don’t receive the same satisfaction from my career as I do from being a mother so I’m really happy.’ Megan recently[gave birth](link_49)to her second child with partner Brian Austin Green. Baby boy Bodhi, is now two months old.

![Image 5: Reese Witherspoon](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-2016362d_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)4 of 15

### Reese Witherspoon

Screen siren Reese Witherspoon, 38, became a mother at the young age of 22 with Ava (now 14). She went on to have another child with husband Ryan Philippe – Deacon (10) – and has recently given birth to her third child with new talent agent husband Jim Toth, Tennessee (19 months).  
 She opened up to a glossy mag about the loneliness she felt having a baby so young, saying, ‘When I first had Ava, I couldn't afford [help]. And it was so hard. I was out in Los Angeles, living [away from my family]. I really didn't have any friends. And I had a baby. No one else who was 22 had a baby. I couldn't go out.’

![Image 6: Kristin Cavallari](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-1887011f_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)5 of 15

### Kristin Cavallari

Former reality star, Kristin Cavallari, 27, is now awaiting the arrival of her:a[second child]{href='https://www.motherandbaby.com/2013/10/kristin-cavallari-has-confirmed-she-is-pregnant-with-her-second-child [link_50]' target='_blank' rel='noreferrer noopener'}with her partner, Chicago Bears quarterback, Jay Cutler, after giving birth to baby Camden in August 2012, aged 25.  
 She told a magazine that it all came earlier than she expected: ‘It’s so crazy to look at your life and see how far you’ve come…I always wanted kids, but I always thought I would have kids later on in life, maybe when I turn 30.’ On getting pregnant: ‘We left it up to fate. I knew there was a possibility, but I was really excited…Even if you are trying, just to see a positive result is shocking!’

![Image 7: Adele Adkins](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-2133863q_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)6 of 15

### Adele Adkins

Grammy and Oscar-winning songstress Adele, 25, gave birth to her baby boy Angelo James (18 months) at the height of her fame, aged 24. Keeping out of the limelight for now, she expressed her happiness in a rare tweet about her personal life, ‘Happy mamas day to all of us! This is my first one! Never been happier :) xx.’

![Image 8: Hilary Duff](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/464994017_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)7 of 15

### Hilary Duff

Hilary Duff, 25, has put her Lizzie McGuire days behind her and alongside husband Mike Comrie welcomed motherhood, aged 24, with baby boy Luca Cruz (two).  
 Speaking to a parenting website, she admitted being a young mother put her at odds with her friends of the same age, ‘I don’t have a lot of people my age who have babies. So I’m at a totally different spot than a lot of my friends…I don’t really know what the alternative is. I do have a lot of energy, I feel great, and I had a really easy pregnancy.’

![Image 9: Sienna Miller](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/478398349_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)8 of 15

### Sienna Miller

Actress Sienna Miller, 32, put her successful career on hold to become a mother to baby Marlowe two years ago, with actor partner Tom Sturridge, four years her junior.  
 Clearly loving motherhood, she told a glossy magazine, ‘I have a wonderful life. I’m up every morning with a little baby. That gives you incredible perspective. It’s such a gift. And it’s grounding in a way you can’t describe. And going back to work is really exciting and fun.’

![Image 10: Beyoncé Knowles](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-1439942i_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)9 of 15

### Beyoncé Knowles

Global superstar Beyoncé, 32, took a break from ‘running the world’ when pregnant with[Blue Ivy](link_51), now two.  
 Despite being back at work, and just completing her Mrs Carter tour earlier this year, the singer wants a normal life for her tot, telling an American chat show, ‘I am very protective. I just want to make sure that she can have a healthy, safe, normal life…in the back of my mind, she’s my priority. And life is completely different now. I feel really, really just lucky that I can still do what I love, and now have a way bigger meaning. And that’s to be her mother.’

![Image 11: Kim Kardashian](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/474246359_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)10 of 15

### Kim Kardashian

One of the most high-profile pregnancies of 2013, Kim Kardashian, 33, and fiancé Kanye West, welcomed baby girl[North West](link_52)to the world in June 2013 and is clearly loving motherhood, ‘It completely changed my life…you have a different set of proprieties …nothing matters except your brand new family.’

![Image 12: Rachel Stevens](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rachel-stevens_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)11 of 15

### Rachel Stevens

Ex S-Club 7 singer and Strictly Come Dancing starRachel Stevens, 36, first became a mother aged 32 with husband Alex Bourne, welcoming baby girl Amelie, now three. Their family has also just got bigger this month with the addition of baby[Minnie Blossom](link_53), just born.  
 Rachel posted on Twitter: ‘We’re so happy that baby has arrived safely. Within minutes of meeting her we were totally smitten. Amelie is happy and ‘cited to have a little sister to play with and we can’t wait to introduce her to the whole family.’

![Image 13: Halle Berry](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-3615863b_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)12 of 15

### Halle Berry

Oscar-winning actress Halle Berry, 47, is one of the high profile celebs who have become mothers later in life – in Halle’s case, aged 41, with Nahla (six) – and has just recently welcomed another bundle of joy into her life,[Maceo](link_54)(seven months).  
 Speaking of motherhood in her forties, she said, ‘I thought I was kind of past the point where this could be a reality for me. So, it’s been a big surprise and the most wonderful.’

![Image 14: Salma Hayek](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/187545424_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)13 of 15

### Salma Hayek

Salma Hayek, 47, and her husband François-Henri Pinault welcomed Valentina, now six, when the actress was aged 41.  
 She has spoken of the benefits of motherhood later in life, saying, ‘It’s a little nerve-racking to wait that long, but it’s the best time...because you’ve done so many other things in your life. You just get it out of your system, and you can really relax into being a mother.... If you’re 23, you don’t know this because you think you have to do so many more things. But if you already did them, then you can really focus and enjoy every minute of it.’

![Image 15: Nicole Kidman](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-825042ae_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)14 of 15

### Nicole Kidman

Nicole Kidman, 46, has spoken often of her 'rollercoaster ride with fertility' and despite adopting two children with ex-husband Tom Cruise, Isabella (21) and Connor (19), she successfully became pregnant with new husband Keith Urban, aged 40.  
 The family now have two adorable girls Faith Margaret (three, born via surrogacy) and Sunday Rose (five, born naturally).  
 Speaking of Faith Margaret’s birth, she said, 'She [the surrogate] was the most wonderful woman to do this for us…I get emotional talking about it because I'm so grateful to her.’

![Image 16: Mariah Carey](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/469227609_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)15 of 15

### Mariah Carey

Mariah Carey, 44, did not believe she would become a mother, but now is over the moon to have her baby twins Monroe and Moroccan, aged two, in her and husband Nick Carter’s life.  
 However, she admitted on a US talk show that this would be it for the family. She said: 'I had a difficult pregnancy and was alone most of the time. ..we love Nick, but he was working! He's the hardest working man in show business.' On[not having any more children](link_55): ‘I had pre-eclampsia, I had gestational diabetes.’

* * *

Rebecca Lancaster is a Digital Writer for Mother&Baby, drawing on ten years of parenting her two children to help others navigating their own parenting journey. Having given birth and parented in both the UK and US, she brings a transatlantic angle but has found that when it comes to parenting, there are more similarities than differences, wherever you are in the world.

[Read more](https://www.motherandbaby.com/author/rebecca-lancaster/#)
As a freelance writer, she spent ten years working with leading lifestyle brands, from travel companies to food and drink start-ups, and writing everything from hotel reviews to guides to the best British cheeses. She brings this experience to Mother&Baby, whether helping parents find the perfect family-friendly destination for their next holiday or the foods their toddlers will (hopefully) love.

When not providing a taxi service to enable her children’s hobbies, she attempts to maintain an allotment, is a keen baker and loves to travel. You can find her on[Instagram](link_44)and[LinkedIn](link_45).

# Louise Thompson: “If I had been allowed to have the c-section I wanted… then none of this would have happened”

![Image 1: Louise Thompson birth](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2024/05/Louise-Thompson-birth.png?ar=16%3A9&fit=crop&crop=top&auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

@Louise Thompson

by[Lorna White](https://www.motherandbaby.com/author/lorna-white/)|

Updated on 29th January 2026 at 9.13am

* * *

[Follow Mother & Baby on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://www.motherandbaby.com)

Whether you remember her from her _Made in Chelsea_ days or have come to know her more recently through her honest birth-recovery journey, Louise Thompson has endured an extraordinary amount over the past few years since releasing her book, _Lucky_. From a devastating miscarriage to a traumatic pregnancy and a birth experience that nearly cost her her life, Louise has turned profound personal pain into purpose, working tirelessly to ensure no other mother has to go through what she did.

## 1. [Lucky](https://www.amazon.com/dp/152992376X?tag=bauer-mab-us-20&ascsubtag=st_on_p_MAB_197850)

![Image 2: Louise Thompson Lucky](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2024/05/Louise-Thompson-Lucky.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)Pål Hansen

![Image 3: Louise Thompson Lucky](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2024/05/Louise-Thompson-Lucky.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

![Image 4: Louise Thompson Lucky](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2024/05/Louise-Thompson-Lucky.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

Rrp: $42.99

[](https://www.amazon.com/dp/152992376X?tag=bauer-mab-us-20&ascsubtag=st_on_p_MAB_197850)

[View offer](https://www.amazon.com/dp/152992376X?tag=bauer-mab-us-20&ascsubtag=st_on_p_MAB_197850)

The day before our interview, Louise had visited Parliament to discuss the recent [Government inquiry into birth trauma in the UK](https://www.motherandbaby.com/mum/mental-health/listen-to-mums-birth-trauma-needs-to-be-taken-seriously-and-how-both-expecting-and-new-parents-can-seek-help-if-they-are-struggling/). “The more conversations I'm having with women that have been through traumatic births, the more I'm realising that it's about so much more than me and my story and how I feel. It feels like a really important time for me to be shining a light on so many of the issues that are kind of ignored by our Government.”

Since we interviewed Louise, she has teamed up with former MP, Theo Clarke to launch a [petition to appoint a Maternity Commissioner](https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/751174) to improve maternity care for mums and babies in the UK. With over 100,000 signatures and counting, MP's will consider it for debate.

## Louise's birth experience

It was November 2021 when Louise went into labour with her baby boy Leo. A regular poster on Instagram, fans were concerned when things went silent over on her account, leaving many of her followers wondering if she was okay. On December 23, she posted for the first time since giving birth. Without giving any details as to what actually happened, it was clear Louise had been through hell. As she began to share more about her experiences, many parents took to the comments section as well as Louise’s DM’s to share their own experiences of childbirth trauma. And although these conversations were difficult for Louise to have at the time while she was in recovery, she finds connecting with mums who have been through similar experiences something she is very passionate about.

“There have been moments throughout recovery where I've had to completely remove myself from pretty much all technology. I couldn't concentrate listening to a podcast, I couldn't read an email, and I definitely couldn't read a DM that came in without being really triggered. But I was in a really sensitive place and mentally unwell when I first came out of hospital.”

It’s almost unfathomable to believe one person could experience such trauma in such a short space of time. From her miscarriage to the house fire during her pregnancy to her harrowing birth experience and the life-threatening illnesses that followed, it’s a miracle Louise is still here.

“Before all of this, my life had been really quite easy.” Louise admits. “I'd always been someone that was really good at communicating and talking. I couldn't imagine that I'd get to a place where I couldn't talk about something for a really long period of time.”

## The changes to NHS maternity care Louise wants to see

Her trauma has not only given Louise a newfound appreciation for life, but her career is taking a diversion into her new passion of helping women going through birth trauma and working with the Government to improve both pre and postnatal care within the NHS.

"From the conversations over the last week and from my own experience, I think that there needs to be better training across the board so that people understand that a traumatic operation can cause mental health consequences afterwards.”

One particular area Louise would like to see be improved is the bedside manner and sensitivity of some health professionals.

“I had a man come up to me saying that I should be up and moving in two days following a c-section when I'd been in the hospital for several weeks because I've been put there because of what happened, not because of my choice. Of course, I'd rather be at home going shopping, but I was completely incapacitated.”

Another area all women can relate to is how seriously women’s pain levels are taken, particularly when it comes to the birth experience. “There's an expectation that all women should have an easy birth, because our bodies are designed to do it naturally. But that's not always the case for people.”

Comparing her postnatal treatment to her recent experience with her stomach issues that led to Louise having a stoma bag fitted, she found that it was managed in a much different way, with health professionals looking out for symptoms and offering more diagnostic testing afterwards.

![Image 5](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2024/05/Louise-Thompson-Book.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

 © Pål Hansen

“If I'm in significant pain following that, they take it seriously, whereas with the maternity department, they're quite quick to discharge people because there's a revolving door of people giving birth all the time.”

Louise would also like to see the mental health of birth partners considered more after witnessing their loved one experience a traumatic birth, recalling how her partner Ryan needed to be Leo’s sole parent with no access to any NHS Care.

“No one once asked him how he was.” Louise recalls. “This is something that the inquiry did highlight, that they need to make more of an effort to ask parents how they are doing, and checklist for potential PTSD symptoms, not just the baby. When the midwives come in to do those checks in the weeks following the birth, they ask about the baby, but the mother isn't really asked about.”

The main area Louise would like to see an improvement on is a mother’s choice around her birth and less resistance when it comes to those choices.

“If I had been allowed to have the c-section I wanted, and I hadn't met so much resistance, and I hadn't been backed into the corner and been made to feel like I was maybe too posh to push and that it was a silly choice, then none of this would have happened.

“I do think that mothers know our bodies best ourselves. To a large degree, there is an instinctual element, especially when it comes to childbirth. And when it comes to birth, we really need to be listened to more.”

## Being aware of your birth rights

After reading Lucky and listening to Louise speak of her experience, taking a stronger stance and being aware of her birth rights is something she wishes she’d have been more knowledgeable of. “I've learned to be more assertive, but I'm not somebody that's a pushy person.” Louise says.

“[Birthrights.org.uk](http://birthrights.org.uk/) is a great reference for what your birth rights are. It's really important to actually figure out in advance, around three months before your due date and really try and learn as much as possible. If you're not listened to, you can request to speak to somebody else. If someone doesn't want to offer you what you want, you can go to your GP and ask to be referred to a different hospital in your local area where you have the choice to choose your birth partner, to choose your hospital and to choose the team. For someone that suffers with severe anxiety, you should be offered extra support. There are things that I just had no idea about and I wish I'd known.”

Despite everything she’s been through, Louise has found the strength to turn her trauma into a mission to help other women know their rights when it comes to birth. “Don't be the person that has to learn from your mistake – learn from my mistake!There are a lot of things that I've had to learn the hard way.”

It’s fair to say Louise’s life will never be the same again, and it’s her passion when talking about the changes she would like to see in maternity care that really shines through. As well as a new podcast in the works hosted by herself and Ryan to discuss both their experiences, Louise is making it her mission to empower women in the way she desperately needed after having Leo.

“The long-term goal would be to set up a charity-funded facility like a mother and baby unit to be a safe place where people could get immediate help following a complicated birth, where they can find psychiatric support, psychological support, in a nice place for people to go.”

## Building a bond with Leo

![Image 6](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2024/05/Louise-Thompson-with-Leo.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

 © Louise Thompson

Perhaps the most raw and honest parts of Louise’s book is her account of bonding with Leo, and how long it took her to get to the point where she and Leo are best friends, something many mums and dads can relate to.

“We're not all naturally good parents and without any experience of parenting, there's an expectation that you are supposed to love and adore this child that is presented to you the moment they come out of you. But actually, I don't think it's that natural to instantly fall in love with someone without knowing what they look like, without actually getting to know them.”

Not only did Louise have to recover physically from her ordeal, which saw her in hospital for most of Leo’s early months, but it was the mental recovery which took the longest time, and that bond with Leo didn’t grow until much later. Louise’s message for mums feeling the same difficulties when it comes to bonding with your baby? Patience, and knowing that soon, with plenty of hugs, the love will come.

“Hopefully I just provide people with reassurance. I know, I felt like I did love my son around the six month mark, and then I looked back at the eight month mark at the six month photos and I’d think ‘no, I really wasn't a good parent then’ I was still quite out of it, I was exhausted, I was disassociated and I wasn't really connecting with him or looking into his eyes. But, in the moments when I felt good, I would put in as much effort as possible.”

And now? “We have a great, great life.” Louise smiles.

With everything Louise’s body has been through the past few years, it’s unsurprising that doctors have strongly advised against her carrying any more children in the future, prompting Louise to consider other options such as [egg freezing](https://www.motherandbaby.com/getting-pregnant/fertility/freezing-eggs-uk-2/) or surrogacy further down the line. However, she admits that just being alive is something she is so grateful for, and getting her physical and mental health back on track is her main priority right now, as well as enjoying life with little Leo and her partner Ryan.

“Mentally, I would never be able to go through that, again. My partner has said categorically, he could not allow me to do that again.” Louise explains. “I do have ovaries, so I was considering freezing eggs in April of this year. But then obviously, I've been in hospital having another surgery. Our only option really, to have a baby that carries our genes would be [through surrogacy](https://www.motherandbaby.com/getting-pregnant/trying-to-conceive/surrogate-mother/).”

“It would be an amazing privilege to have a second child, for Leo to have a sibling.”

Since our conversation, Louise [has recently shared](https://www.instagram.com/p/DUEFdyXDIRk/) she and Ryan have begun their IVF and surrogacy journey.

In her spare time, she enjoys spending time with her two young sisters, dog walking and enjoying the outdoors with her family._

# Betrayals, baby bumps and big reveals: Roxy Wilson talks The Traitors and becoming a first time mum

![Image 1: A collection of photographs of Roxy Wilson from season 4 of the hit BBC show The Traitors.](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/02/1-1.jpg?ar=16%3A9&fit=crop&crop=top&auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

@BBC/Studio Lambert/Euan Cherry/ Roxy Wilson

by[Hannah Carroll](https://www.motherandbaby.com/author/hannah-carroll/)|

Updated on 10th February 2026 at 12.46pm

* * *

[Follow Mother & Baby on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://www.motherandbaby.com)

Season four of The Traitors kept us guessing until the very last twist. There were family secrets, surprise couples, and a wardrobe so dramatic it deserved its own storyline (we’re looking at you, Stephen). And when the final accusations were laid to rest, one contestant stood out above the intrigue: Roxy, The Traitors' fan favourite, whose theories sometimes missed the mark, but whose warmth and charisma never did.

Now, in a twist worthy of the show itself, Roxy The Traitors star has revealed her biggest news yet: she’s expecting a baby girl, and she couldn’t be happier. Her exciting announcement follows in the footsteps of previous Traitors winner [Leanne Quigley](https://www.motherandbaby.com/family-life/influencers-inspiration/leanne-quigley/), who previously opened up about her plans for more children.

## From deceit to dummies

![Image 2: Roxy Wilson at the train station awaiting to start her journey on the BBC TV show The Traitors](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/02/1.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

![Image 3](https://cdn.tagdeliver.com/cipt/a/brand-dark.svg)About our ads![Image 4](https://cdn.tagdeliver.com/cipt/a/close-dark.svg)Close this ad

Roxy was a ray of sunshine  © BBC/Studio Lambert/Euan Cherry

Roxy Wilson first appeared on our screens as one of Claudia Winkleman’s chosen Faithful, stepping into the castle ready to outwit the Traitors. What viewers didn’t know at first was that she wasn’t playing the game alone. Hidden from the rest of the cast was a deeply personal secret: her mum, Judy, was also competing as a Faithful.

Judy, who adopted Roxy when she was a child, sadly didn’t get long to enjoy the adventure. She was banished at the very first 'Round Table' after suspicion fell her way, an early and emotional exit that added an unexpected layer to Roxy’s journey in the game.

Despite the twists, the nation quickly warmed to Roxy’s loyalty, infectious energy, and endearing honesty. She wore her heart on her sleeve, forming friendships with ease and placing her trust generously, sometimes a little too generously, she admits with a laugh.

“I couldn’t spot the Traitors,” she jokes, “so I don’t think I’ll be able to tell if my child’s lying to me, to be honest!”

![Image 5: All of the cast members of season 4 of the BBC hit TV show, The Traitors. Including Roxy Wilson.](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/02/Roxy_Traitors-3.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

 © BBC/Studio Lambert/Euan Cherry

## Mum-to-be on a mission

When we sit down with Roxy in our London studio, she is glowing, not just with pregnancy, but with unmistakable joy. She speaks with warmth and wonder about the months ahead, clearly still amazed by the experience of it all.

“Honestly, life is lifing right now, it’s wild. Everything is so positive and lovely, but it’s also a complete whirlwind. Between the baby, The Traitors, and my mum, especially now that we’re spending so much more time together, there’s so much going on.

“But I feel really wonderful, honestly. I never expected pregnancy to feel this good,” she says, smiling. “My body’s strength has surprised me. It’s amazing what we can do,” she says.

![Image 6: Roxy Wilson and mum Judy Wilson pictured. Left with fellow The Traitors cast mates and right embracing.](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/02/Roxy_Traitors-4.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

 © Roxy Wilson

Roxy has left her home in Amsterdam to join her mum, Judy, in publicly supporting proposed [changes to the fostering system](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpwngvlzgg4o). The pair are backing plans that would make it easier for single or unmarried people, renters, and those in full-time work to open their homes to children in need of care across England. If approved, the reforms could create up to 10,000 additional foster placements by 2029/30. A goal Roxy and Judy hope will make a real difference to [people considering fostering](https://www.motherandbaby.com/getting-pregnant/trying-to-conceive/fostering-v-adoption/).

“When you’ve been through so many ups and downs as a child, and then you’re bringing your own child into the world, all you want to do is protect them and make everything as good as possible," Roxy explains, " At the same time, I know families aren’t perfect, no one is. What really matters is that a child feels loved, happy and safe. There will always be challenges, so I’m learning to embrace them too.”

## Staying true in a game of lies

Roxy’s journey on the show wasn't just about guessing who was deceiving whom; it was about growing into her own strengths. She says, "Just be in this world and be yourself. I think that’s so important. I spent a lot of my younger years trying to fit in or not even knowing who I was, and it’s hard to fully embrace yourself, both the good and the bad. But once you do, you feel genuinely happy and comfortable in your own skin."

![Image 7: Roxy pictured with her fellow showmates Stephen and Rachel on the hit BBC TV show, The Traitors.](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/02/3.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

Roxy  © BBC/Studio Lambert/Euan Cherry

The 32-year-old hopes these hard-earned lessons aren’t just for the cameras. When asked what she wants her daughter to take from her story, Roxy beams: “Just resilience, strength, and see the good in the world, even though bad happens, just be positive, and you get one life. It’s a journey.”

## From the Traitors castle to cot shopping

Life has thrown Roxy more than a few surprises since leaving The Traitors, and she is now gearing up for her most exciting adventure yet, her first baby with partner David. Of course, her mum Judy was among the first to hear the news, making her set to become a grandmother for the 12th time. True to her signature calm attitude, Roxy is embracing motherhood with a relaxed, hopeful approach.

“We’ve been given a few little clothes from people, but otherwise we’re very, very laid back,” she says. “So we’re actually trying now to take some action and plan a little bit, because she’s going to be coming soon.”

![Image 8: Roxy and her partner David are expecting their first child together.](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/02/4.jpg?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

Roxy The Traitors alumni is expecting her first child with partner David © Roxy Wilson

When it comes to parenting, Roxy’s philosophy is simple: let her daughter shine in her own way. “I don’t want to hold my little girl back from being herself, quirks and all,” she explains. “I just think, embrace you and don’t try and fit in. I want to give her the freedom to just do what she wants.”

When we asked Roxy what she thinks her daughter will make of The Traitors when she’s old enough to watch, she laughed. “Oh, God, poor thing. She’ll never look at me the same again! But yes, I’m sure she’ll watch it. I think she’ll be proud of me… though she’ll probably also be joining everyone else, screaming at me when I insist that Stephen wasn’t a traitor.”

If her daughter inherits even a little of Roxy’s honesty, humour, and wholehearted approach to life, she’s sure to face the world with the same fearless spirit. And while we tried to tease out her [baby girl’s name](https://www.motherandbaby.com/baby-names/girls/unusual-names/), in true Traitors style, Roxy is keeping that secret firmly under wraps.

Mother & Baby is dedicated to ensuring our information is always valuable and trustworthy, which is why we only use reputable resources such as the NHS, reviewed medical papers, or the advice of a credible doctor, GP, midwife, psychotherapist, gynaecologist or other medical professionals. Where possible, our articles are medically reviewed or contain expert advice. Our writers are all kept up to date on the latest safety advice for all the products we recommend and follow strict reporting guidelines to ensure our content comes from credible sources. # Sophie Habboo and Jamie Laing launch new podcast

![Image 1: Jamie Laing and Sophie Haboo at the premiere of Raising Chelsea and the first photo of the couple with baby Ziggy](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/03/Jamie-Laing-and-Sophie-Haboo.png?ar=16%3A9&fit=crop&crop=top&auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

@Getty / Dave Benett / Sophie Haboo and Jamie Laing Instagram

by[Lorna White](https://www.motherandbaby.com/author/lorna-white/)|

Updated on 23rd April 2026 at 10.28am

* * *

[Follow Mother & Baby on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://www.motherandbaby.com)

Sophie Habboo and Jamie Laing are two of the most recognisable faces to come out of Made in Chelsea, but their story has moved well beyond SW3 drama. Now married and settling into life as new parents, the couple are opening the doors to their next chapter with their new docuseries, [Raising Chelsea](https://press.disney.co.uk/news/jamie-laing-and-sophie-habboos-next-chapter-raising-chelsea-due-2-april-on-disney).

For anyone who’s followed their journey, from friendship to romance, engagement, and now life with baby Ziggy, it feels like a natural progression. Here’s a closer look at their relationship, their new podcast, and what to expect from the series.

## Who are Sophie Habboo and Jamie Laing?

[Jamie Laing](https://www.instagram.com/jamielaing/?hl=en) first appeared on Made in Chelsea back in 2011, quickly becoming known for his cheeky humour and, at times, complicated dating life. Over the years, he’s also built a successful business with his confectionery brand [Candy Kittens](https://candykittens.co.uk/pages/jamie-laing), now stocked across the UK.

[Sophie Habboo](https://www.instagram.com/sophiehabboo/?hl=en) joined the show in 2017 and was soon affectionately nicknamed “Habbs”. With her straight-talking approach and close friendships on the series, she quickly became a fan favourite.  
 While both found fame in their own right, it’s their relationship that’s really captured people’s attention.

![Image 2: Jamie Laing and Sophie Habboo walking with pram with baby Ziggy](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/03/Jamie-and-Sophie-walking-with-pram.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

![Image 3](https://cdn.tagdeliver.com/cipt/a/brand-dark.svg)About our ads![Image 4](https://cdn.tagdeliver.com/cipt/a/close-dark.svg)Close this ad

 © Instagram Sophie Habboo

## How did they meet?

Although they moved in the same circles, romance didn’t happen straight away. When Sophie first joined Made in Chelsea, their connection was more friendship than anything else, and Jamie was still navigating his (very public) love life.

Things changed in 2019, when their friendship developed into something more off-screen. Viewers later watched their relationship unfold on the show, and while it wasn’t without its challenges, it felt more grounded than many of the romances fans had seen before.

Jamie has been open about his struggles with anxiety and commitment, and their relationship has often been shaped by honest conversations around those experiences. He proposed in 2021, and the couple married in 2023, celebrating first in London before a larger wedding in Spain.

**Love our content?**[Click here](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=motherandbaby.com)**to add Mother&Baby as your preferred source on Google.**

## Sophie and Jamie's new podcast

Sophie and Jamie are stepping into their next chapter with the launch of a brand new podcast, _NewlyParents_, beginning on 27 April.

Following on from _NearlyParents_ and hot on the heels of _Raising Chelsea_, the new show will document their journey through parenthood - with all the chaos, comedy and candid conversations fans have come to expect.

While listeners can expect plenty of relatable moments around sleepless nights and the realities of life with a newborn, _NewlyParents_ promises to go far beyond nappies and night feeds. The couple will explore how becoming parents impacts identity, ambition, relationships and family dynamics, as well as the pressures of navigating major life changes in the public eye.

Building on the success of _NearlyWeds_, _NewlyWeds_ and _NearlyParents_ - and with _NearlyWeds_ now hosted by _Love Island: All Stars_ winners Molly Smith and Tom Clare - Sophie and Jamie’s latest venture continues the podcast journey their audience has followed from engagement to marriage and now parenthood.

![Image 5: NewlyParents](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/03/NewlyParents.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

 © JamPot

## What is Raising Chelsea about?

Their new series, Raising Chelsea, follows them as they adjust to life as first-time parents while juggling busy careers and a very public profile.

Expect a mix of everyday family moments and more candid conversations about the pressures of modern parenting. Early glimpses of the show suggest it doesn’t shy away from the tougher parts either – from disagreements to anxieties around pregnancy and those early newborn days.

## Life with baby Ziggy

![Image 6: Sophie Habboo holding baby Ziggy](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/2026/03/Sophie-Habboo-baby-Ziggy.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

 © Instagram Sophie Habboo

At the heart of it all is their son, Ziggy. Both Sophie and Jamie have shared snippets of parenthood through social media, often describing it as equal parts joyful and overwhelming.

Like many new parents, they’ve spoken about the realities – the sleepless nights, the learning curve, and the constant juggle of work and home life.

Speaking on [Elizabeth Day’s How To Fail](https://podcasts.apple.com/gb/podcast/sophie-habboo-i-wish-i-had-more-boundaries/id1407451189?i=1000760073016) podcast, Sophie also opened up about the emotional side of motherhood, including “mum guilt” and the constant self-doubt many parents experience.

“I feel content being a mother. Of course, I have doubts, I worry, and I feel mum guilt, but I think that’s completely normal. I hope, and I feel, that I’m doing a good job. He’s such a happy little boy and so loved.

I always thought I’d be quite strict, but I think I’ll probably be the opposite, just completely obsessed and letting him get away with anything. I used to say to Jamie, ‘Your relationship with your mum is a bit weird, you love each other too much.’ But now that I’m a mum to a boy, I completely get it.”

At the same time, they’ve been mindful about how much of Ziggy’s life they share publicly, something more and more parents in the spotlight are thinking carefully about.

**You can watch [Raising Chelsea on Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/en-gb), streaming from April 2nd, 2026**

# How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?

![Image 1: How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rebecca-ferguson_c1.png?ar=16%3A9&fit=crop&crop=top&auto=format&w=2560&q=80)

by[Rebecca Lancaster](https://www.motherandbaby.com/author/rebecca-lancaster/)|

Updated on 10th March 2026 at 1.05pm

* * *

[Follow Mother & Baby on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://www.motherandbaby.com)

What age do you think is the best time to become a mother? According to recent statistics, nearly half (49%) of all live births were to mothers aged 30 and over, with the average age for first-time mothers coming in at 28.1 years.

But what about celebrities? We round up some of the most high-profile mothers, from Adele and Lily Allen who chose to become mothers in their twenties, to Halle Berry and Nicole Kidman who are welcoming bundles of joy into their lives well into their forties...

## How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?

![Image 2: How Old Were These Celebrity Mums When They Had Their First Baby?](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rebecca-ferguson_c1.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)1 of 15

### Rebecca Ferguson

Singer and X-Factor finalist Rebecca, 27, became a mum at the tender age of 18 with ex-partner Karl Dures and has a daughter Lillie May, 10, and son Karl Jr, eight.'  
 Karl was my first love. It was a surprise when Lillie May came along and it was hard to deal with, but a lot of young girls are in that situation,’ she said of her first pregnancy. Rebecca has recently confirmed that she is[now pregnant with her third child](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2014/04/x-factor-s-rebecca-ferguson-is-pregnant-with-her-third-child/)with her current partner, who has chosen to stay out of the limelight.

![Image 3: Lily Allen](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-3216288ar_c1.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)2 of 15

### Lily Allen

Lily Allen, 28, first became a mother at 26 with Ethel, now two, and welcomed her second child with husband Sam Cooper in January 2013, Marnie (15 months).  
 The outspoken singer made her pop comeback last year after a three-year career break, telling a French radio station, ‘I thought I'd be a really happy mum just sitting at home, playing with my kids; that was my dream. I love my children, but I'm a very impatient, busy person naturally so two babies, neither of them can talk, it was[quite boring](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2014/02/can-you-relate-to-lily-allen-s-motherhood-confession/)!’

![Image 4: Megan Fox](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/157928596_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)3 of 15

### Megan Fox

Voted the World’s Sexiest Woman on numerous occasions, actress and Transformers star Megan Fox, 27, became a mum in her mid-twenties with baby Noah (16 months).  
 Happy to settle down, she told a newspaper: ‘I love it. It’s what I’ve wanted to do since I was a little girl. I always wanted to mother things and I constantly had a doll I was taking care of. I don’t receive the same satisfaction from my career as I do from being a mother so I’m really happy.’ Megan recently[gave birth](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2014/02/it-s-a-boy-megan-fox-and-brian-austin-green-welcome-new-baby/)to her second child with partner Brian Austin Green. Baby boy Bodhi, is now two months old.

![Image 5: Reese Witherspoon](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-2016362d_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)4 of 15

### Reese Witherspoon

Screen siren Reese Witherspoon, 38, became a mother at the young age of 22 with Ava (now 14). She went on to have another child with husband Ryan Philippe – Deacon (10) – and has recently given birth to her third child with new talent agent husband Jim Toth, Tennessee (19 months).  
 She opened up to a glossy mag about the loneliness she felt having a baby so young, saying, ‘When I first had Ava, I couldn't afford [help]. And it was so hard. I was out in Los Angeles, living [away from my family]. I really didn't have any friends. And I had a baby. No one else who was 22 had a baby. I couldn't go out.’

![Image 6: Kristin Cavallari](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-1887011f_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)5 of 15

### Kristin Cavallari

Former reality star, Kristin Cavallari, 27, is now awaiting the arrival of her:a[second child]{href='https://www.motherandbaby.com/2013/10/kristin-cavallari-has-confirmed-she-is-pregnant-with-her-second-child' target='_blank' rel='noreferrer noopener'}with her partner, Chicago Bears quarterback, Jay Cutler, after giving birth to baby Camden in August 2012, aged 25.  
 She told a magazine that it all came earlier than she expected: ‘It’s so crazy to look at your life and see how far you’ve come…I always wanted kids, but I always thought I would have kids later on in life, maybe when I turn 30.’ On getting pregnant: ‘We left it up to fate. I knew there was a possibility, but I was really excited…Even if you are trying, just to see a positive result is shocking!’

![Image 7: Adele Adkins](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-2133863q_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)6 of 15

### Adele Adkins

Grammy and Oscar-winning songstress Adele, 25, gave birth to her baby boy Angelo James (18 months) at the height of her fame, aged 24. Keeping out of the limelight for now, she expressed her happiness in a rare tweet about her personal life, ‘Happy mamas day to all of us! This is my first one! Never been happier :) xx.’

![Image 8: Hilary Duff](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/464994017_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)7 of 15

### Hilary Duff

Hilary Duff, 25, has put her Lizzie McGuire days behind her and alongside husband Mike Comrie welcomed motherhood, aged 24, with baby boy Luca Cruz (two).  
 Speaking to a parenting website, she admitted being a young mother put her at odds with her friends of the same age, ‘I don’t have a lot of people my age who have babies. So I’m at a totally different spot than a lot of my friends…I don’t really know what the alternative is. I do have a lot of energy, I feel great, and I had a really easy pregnancy.’

![Image 9: Sienna Miller](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/478398349_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)8 of 15

### Sienna Miller

Actress Sienna Miller, 32, put her successful career on hold to become a mother to baby Marlowe two years ago, with actor partner Tom Sturridge, four years her junior.  
 Clearly loving motherhood, she told a glossy magazine, ‘I have a wonderful life. I’m up every morning with a little baby. That gives you incredible perspective. It’s such a gift. And it’s grounding in a way you can’t describe. And going back to work is really exciting and fun.’

![Image 10: Beyoncé Knowles](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-1439942i_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)9 of 15

### Beyoncé Knowles

Global superstar Beyoncé, 32, took a break from ‘running the world’ when pregnant with[Blue Ivy](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2014/04/bey-utiful-beyonce-shares-intimate-family-photographs/), now two.  
 Despite being back at work, and just completing her Mrs Carter tour earlier this year, the singer wants a normal life for her tot, telling an American chat show, ‘I am very protective. I just want to make sure that she can have a healthy, safe, normal life…in the back of my mind, she’s my priority. And life is completely different now. I feel really, really just lucky that I can still do what I love, and now have a way bigger meaning. And that’s to be her mother.’

![Image 11: Kim Kardashian](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/474246359_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)10 of 15

### Kim Kardashian

One of the most high-profile pregnancies of 2013, Kim Kardashian, 33, and fiancé Kanye West, welcomed baby girl[North West](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2014/01/cute-kim-kardashian-shares-new-pics-of-north-west/)to the world in June 2013 and is clearly loving motherhood, ‘It completely changed my life…you have a different set of proprieties …nothing matters except your brand new family.’

![Image 12: Rachel Stevens](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rachel-stevens_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)11 of 15

### Rachel Stevens

Ex S-Club 7 singer and Strictly Come Dancing starRachel Stevens, 36, first became a mother aged 32 with husband Alex Bourne, welcoming baby girl Amelie, now three. Their family has also just got bigger this month with the addition of baby[Minnie Blossom](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2014/04/rachel-stevens-has-named-her-baby-girl-but-what-do-you-think-of-her-choice/), just born.  
 Rachel posted on Twitter: ‘We’re so happy that baby has arrived safely. Within minutes of meeting her we were totally smitten. Amelie is happy and ‘cited to have a little sister to play with and we can’t wait to introduce her to the whole family.’

![Image 13: Halle Berry](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-3615863b_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)12 of 15

### Halle Berry

Oscar-winning actress Halle Berry, 47, is one of the high profile celebs who have become mothers later in life – in Halle’s case, aged 41, with Nahla (six) – and has just recently welcomed another bundle of joy into her life,[Maceo](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2013/10/it-s-a-boy-halle-berry-welcomes-a-son/)(seven months).  
 Speaking of motherhood in her forties, she said, ‘I thought I was kind of past the point where this could be a reality for me. So, it’s been a big surprise and the most wonderful.’

![Image 14: Salma Hayek](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/187545424_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)13 of 15

### Salma Hayek

Salma Hayek, 47, and her husband François-Henri Pinault welcomed Valentina, now six, when the actress was aged 41.  
 She has spoken of the benefits of motherhood later in life, saying, ‘It’s a little nerve-racking to wait that long, but it’s the best time...because you’ve done so many other things in your life. You just get it out of your system, and you can really relax into being a mother.... If you’re 23, you don’t know this because you think you have to do so many more things. But if you already did them, then you can really focus and enjoy every minute of it.’

![Image 15: Nicole Kidman](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/rexfeatures-825042ae_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)14 of 15

### Nicole Kidman

Nicole Kidman, 46, has spoken often of her 'rollercoaster ride with fertility' and despite adopting two children with ex-husband Tom Cruise, Isabella (21) and Connor (19), she successfully became pregnant with new husband Keith Urban, aged 40.  
 The family now have two adorable girls Faith Margaret (three, born via surrogacy) and Sunday Rose (five, born naturally).  
 Speaking of Faith Margaret’s birth, she said, 'She [the surrogate] was the most wonderful woman to do this for us…I get emotional talking about it because I'm so grateful to her.’

![Image 16: Mariah Carey](https://images.bauerhosting.com/affiliates/sites/12/motherandbaby/2021/08/469227609_c1_.png?auto=format&w=2560&q=80)15 of 15

### Mariah Carey

Mariah Carey, 44, did not believe she would become a mother, but now is over the moon to have her baby twins Monroe and Moroccan, aged two, in her and husband Nick Carter’s life.  
 However, she admitted on a US talk show that this would be it for the family. She said: 'I had a difficult pregnancy and was alone most of the time. ..we love Nick, but he was working! He's the hardest working man in show business.' On[not having any more children](https://www.motherandbaby.com/2013/12/mariah-carey-reveals-why-she-won-t-have-more-children/): ‘I had pre-eclampsia, I had gestational diabetes.’
